name: Chat message
summary: A single message bubble in a conversation: sender identity, body text, timestamp and delivery status. The building block of chat interfaces.

anatomy.purpose: Sender image or initials. Omitted for consecutive messages from the same sender.
Holds the message body. Aligned to the trailing edge for the current user, leading edge for others.
Shown in group conversations to distinguish senders.
The message text or attachment. Wraps; never truncated.
Timestamp and, for sent messages, delivery status (sent, delivered, read).

variants.name: Sent (current user)
variants.use: Messages from the person using the app.

contentLimits.body: no hard limit; visually cap at about 60 characters per line

variants.name: System
variants.use: Join/leave notices, date dividers, encryption notices.

whenToUse: Realtime or near-realtime exchange between two or more people.
Support conversations embedded in a product.
Any thread where authorship and order matter.
whenNotToUse: One-way announcements: use a banner or toast instead.
Long-form async discussion with threading: use a comment thread instead.
Status updates about a task: use a timeline instead.

accessibility.role: log (the message list); each message is a listitem or article
keyboard: Message list is scrollable with the keyboard; focus moves message by message.
Interactive elements inside a message (links, buttons, reactions) are in the tab order.
New messages are announced via aria-live=polite on the log region; do not use assertive.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on every interactive element inside the message; the list container itself is focusable only if it scrolls.
notes: Do not convey sent/received by color alone; align side and label status in text.
Status icons need accessible names ('Read at 14:02', not just a double check).
Body text must meet 4.5:1 on the bubble background in both themes.
